neighbours.label: function words in methodological caveats about data and measurement (records reliable, data may not be)
fire: Because the station moved twice, adjustments are made so that the rainfall series can be compared over time.
Crime statistics based on police reports may not be complete, since many thefts are never reported.
The census figures used to estimate migration may be biased in districts with low response rates.
To ensure that the readings are consistent, each thermometer is calibrated against the same standard.
Self-reported income data may not be accurate, so the survey is weighted against tax records.
The last year for which complete hospital admission data are available is 2019.
Sampling errors are larger for small groups, so the estimates for rural areas should be treated with caution.
Older tide-gauge records were corrected so that changes in instruments do not distort the trend.
quiet: Because the family moved twice, the children changed schools and had to make new friends each time.
The old bakery on the corner may not be open on Sunday, since the owner visits her sister.
The kayaks used on the lake trip were borrowed from the neighbours down the road.
To ensure that the guests are comfortable, each room is heated before they arrive.
The new sofa may not fit through the door, so the movers will take the legs off first.

The trail is steeper near the top, so hikers with small children should take the lower path.
The old fence was repaired so that the goats do not wander into the neighbour's garden.
